hook: Jim Keller has spent four decades moving between the biggest names in semiconductors, leaving a distinct architecture behind at each stop. He led design of AMD's Zen microarchitecture, the chip line credited with reviving the company's competitiveness against Intel, and earlier led the engineering behind Apple's A4 and A5 mobile processors after Apple acquired P.A. Semi. He later ran Autopilot hardware engineering at Tesla and Silicon Engineering at Intel before moving into AI accelerator chips. He is now CEO of Tenstorrent and has also co-founded Atomic Semi, a startup building small-scale chip fabs.
name: Jim Keller

quote.text: Software 2.0 is the largest opportunity for computing innovation in a long time. Victory requires a comprehensive re-thinking of compute and low level software.

quick_facts: CEO of Tenstorrent, an AI chip company, since January 2023, after joining as President and CTO in January 2021
Chief architect of AMD's Zen microarchitecture, hired as Corporate Vice President and Chief Architect in August 2012
Led engineering on Apple's A4 and A5 mobile processors following Apple's 2008 acquisition of P.A. Semi, where he was Vice President of Engineering
Vice President of Autopilot Hardware Engineering at Tesla starting in 2016
Senior Vice President leading the Silicon Engineering Group at Intel from April 2018 to 2020
Co-founded semiconductor fabrication startup Atomic Semi, later rebranded Fab2, with Sam Zeloof

achievements.title: AMD Zen architecture
achievements.impact: Hired in August 2012 as Corporate Vice President and Chief Architect of AMD's Microprocessor Cores group. His team's Zen architecture is widely credited with restoring AMD's competitiveness against Intel.

achievements.title: Apple A4 and A5 processors
achievements.impact: Led engineering at P.A. Semi, acquired by Apple in 2008, on the custom silicon that became the A4 and A5 chips used in early iPhones and iPads.

achievements.title: Tesla Autopilot hardware
achievements.impact: As Vice President of Autopilot Hardware Engineering starting in 2016, led development of Tesla's in-house self-driving computer hardware.

achievements.title: Intel Silicon Engineering Group
achievements.impact: Led Intel's Silicon Engineering Group as Senior Vice President from April 2018, overseeing system-on-chip development and integration.

achievements.title: CEO, Tenstorrent
achievements.impact: Became CEO of AI chip company Tenstorrent in January 2023 after joining as President, CTO and board member in 2021.
